title: Profile
subtitle: Manage your account information
oauthNoPasswordNotice: This account signs in via {{provider}}, so there's no password to change.
removeMemberConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the family? This action cannot be undone.
transferOwnershipConfirm: Transfer ownership to {{name}}? You will become a regular member.
leaveFamilyConfirm: Leave this family? You will lose access to its data.
revokeOtherSessionsConfirm: Log out of all other devices? Those devices will need to sign in again.
otherSessionsRevoked: Logged out of all other devices
revokeOtherSessionsButton: Log out of all other devices
recoveryCodesNotice: 2FA has been enabled successfully. Save the recovery codes below somewhere safe — each one can only be used once if you lose access to your authenticator device. They won't be shown again.
confirmDisablePasswordLabel: Enter your password to confirm disabling 2FA
twoFactorStatusDisabledSuffix: Turn it on to require an extra verification code on every login.
twoFactorModalSubtitle: Every login will also ask for a 6-digit code from your phone — it changes every 30 seconds.
twoFactorStepScanHint: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy...) and scan the code below.
twoFactorManualEntryLabel: Can’t scan it? Enter this key manually:
copyFailed: Couldn’t copy — please copy it manually
twoFactorStepVerifyHint: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app to finish.
confirmDisableCodeLabel: Enter an authentication code (or recovery code) to confirm disabling 2FA
changeEmailNotice: We will send a confirmation link to the new address. The email only changes once you open that link, and every device is signed out so you log in again.
changeEmailSent: A confirmation link was sent to {{email}}. Please check your inbox.
changeEmailFailed: Could not request the email change
reauthNeedsTwoFactor: This account signs in through {{provider}} and has no password. Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) below to do this.
exportDataNotice: Download a copy of your account details, the families you belong to and your login sessions as a JSON file (no passwords or secrets included).
exportFailed: Could not download your personal data
deleteAccountNotice: Permanently delete your account. If you are the owner of a family that still has other members, transfer ownership first. A family with only you in it is deleted too. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccountConfirm: Your account will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. Are you sure you want to continue?
